decoded_text: {"obligations":[{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Everything is measured and recorded in centimeters — no inches anywhere in the live protocol or the log."},{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Log entries are never deleted; if an entry is wrong, mark it VOID with a one-line reason and leave it in place."},{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Every alteration ID starts with the prefix GAV followed by a four-digit sequence number, so GAV-0001, GAV-0002 and so on."},{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Write for our volunteer stitchers — plain language, and any tailoring term of art gets a one-line gloss the first time it appears in a section."},{"source_ids":["msg-05"],"text":"This production only. Harborside's other fall show, 'Rope Ladder,' keeps its own tracker, and I don't want our document drifting into a company template."},{"source_ids":["msg-05"],"text":"Rush handling: anything due within 48 hours of a performance is a rush item — tag it 48H in the status line and float it to the top of the daily pull list."},{"source_ids":["msg-05"],"text":"Approvals: any alteration estimated over $150 in materials or labor goes in as PENDING-PM and can only be marked APPROVED once Ines Duarte, our production manager, initials it. At or under $150, Devon Okafor, my first hand, or I can approve directly."},{"source_ids":["msg-06"],"text":"Dual initials (stitcher plus dresser) on every sub-30-second quick-change completion, and rentals exempted from append-only — returned rentals move to the archive sheet and leave the active log, with the owner-permission scan gating any permanent alteration approval."},{"source_ids":["msg-07"],"text":"Rental (Costumers' Attic, six pieces): exempt from append-only — on return, entries move to the archive sheet and are struck from the active log; no APPROVED permanent alteration without a scanned owner-permission note."},{"source_ids":["msg-09"],"text":"Capture them on the entry. Every alteration entry carries a measurement snapshot — the wearer's bust, waist, and hip in centimeters, taken at the time the alteration is logged."},{"source_ids":["msg-10"],"text":"Measurement snapshot (bust/waist/hip, cm, at logging time) is a required field on every entry."},{"source_ids":["msg-21"],"text":"Tech week (October 5–8) only, HM/TI/LO/SA/CS/SR may stand in for the six full alteration names; outside that window the codes are banned."},{"source_ids":["msg-25"],"text":"The snapshot is again a required field on every entry, and retirement-window entries get backfilled — that supersedes the 'stop the field going forward' instruction for that window."},{"source_ids":["msg-26"],"text":"The tech-week shorthand allowance never touched snapshot requirements, so even an HM-coded tech-week entry needs its snapshot."}]}
